mentions.name: Banker.so
mentions.description: This project provides an LLM-driven virtual computer inside an agent, featuring a direct filesystem with programmatic control over slide builders, spreadsheets, terminals and vibecoding applications. It began as a spreadsheet controlled by an LLM.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Banker.so | Computer inside a computer inside an agent

Started this out by building a spreadsheet controlled by an LLM. Now putting a direct filesystem inside, simplified enough to have programmatic control of slide builders, spreadsheets, terminals and vibecoding applications
